stem:
A student pours 14 grams of sugar into a jar filled with 500 milliliters of water. The student thoroughly stirs the sugar and water to make a solution.

Which change most likely occurs to the sugar when it is added to the water?

options.label: F
options.text: The sugar breaks down to form a new substance in the solution.

options.label: G
options.text: The sugar changes water into a new substance in the solution.

options.label: H
options.text: The sugar floats on the surface of the water in the solution.

options.label: J
options.text: The sugar completely dissolves in the solution.
